description: ΑΔΕΙΟΔΟΤΗΣΗ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΠΑΡΑΓΩΓΩΝ ΖΕΥΓΩΝ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΚΑΡΑΓΚΙΖΟΠΟΥΛΟΥ ΠΗΝΕΛΟΠΗ. LICENSERING AF ELEKTRONISKE PAIR PRODUCERE FRA 2015 og fremefter. Coverage: ΚΑΡΑΓΚΙΖΟΠΟΥΛΟΥ ΠΗΝΕΛΟΠΗ. The portal shows the English title as "ЛІЦЕНЗУВАННЯ ВИРОБНИКІВ ЕЛЕКТРОПАРИ" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΚΑΡΑΓΚΙΖΟΠΟΥΛΟΥ ΠΗΝΕΛΟΠΗ. Its keywords include Αναπτυξη, Φωκίδα, Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 2026-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
